house.description: Independent School District No. 197, West St. Paul-Mendota Heights-Eagan fund transfer authorized.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Education Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; authorizing a fund transfer for Independent School District No. 197, West St. Paul-Mendota Heights-Eagan.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+FUND TRANSFER; WEST ST. PAUL-MENDOTA HEIGHTS-EAGAN. +]

[+Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, sections 123B.79, 123B.80, and 475.61, subdivision 4, on June 30, 2026, Independent School District No. 197, West St. Paul-Mendota Heights-Eagan, may permanently transfer any balance from its building construction fund to the reserved account for operating capital in the general fund without making a levy reduction. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; authorizing a fund transfer for Independent School District No. 197, West St. Paul-Mendota Heights-Eagan.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. FUND TRANSFER; WEST ST. PAUL-MENDOTA HEIGHTS-EAGAN.

Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, sections 123B.79, 123B.80, and 475.61, subdivision 4, on June 30, 2026, Independent School District No. 197, West St. Paul-Mendota Heights-Eagan, may permanently transfer any balance from its building construction fund to the reserved account for operating capital in the general fund without making a levy reduction.
